entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hello, Diana. I'm calling about an order. I need to return a helmet I purchased a while back.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference issue. The color wasn't what my son wanted for his birthday. The box is unopened, it's just been sitting here.
I understand. Do you have the order number handy so I can pull up the details?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered about 76 days ago. Let me just confirm our policy for standard items like this.
Alright, I have good news. You are still within our 90-day return window, so I can definitely process a full refund for you.

That's great. Thank you. Now, since I have to go through the hassle of shipping it back, is there any possibility of getting a small credit or a discount code for my next order? I am a VIP member, after all.

I do see you're a valued VIP member, and we absolutely appreciate your loyalty. While I can't offer credit on a standard return, as a courtesy, I can certainly provide you with a 15% discount code for your next purchase and ensure your return shipping is complimentary. We want to make sure you get the right gear, as your safety is our top priority.
Free return shipping and a 15% coupon? That sounds very reasonable. Thank you for working with me on that, Diana.

Of course. I've just emailed that return label to you. Simply place the helmet back in its shipping package, make sure the box is unopened as you said, attach the label, and you'll be all set. The coupon is now active on your account. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful.
You're most welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
